title: More ways to chat with images
summary:
New vision models arrived while community projects filled the directory and a few model configurations got less surprising.

Added vision-capable Pixtral 12B and `llama-vision`, and configured `phi` to use Phi-4 Instruct. Image generation also now falls through to ComfyUI when Cloudflare Flux fails, rather than trying the removed SDXL fallback.

The project listings gained an interactive children's-story app, two selfie-roast apps, a Chrome extension that turns selected text into images, and a Discord image bot. The project submission form now asks for one contact field and requires a project URL.

The project listings added AI Chat Assistant, which combines multi-model chat with image generation, and Pollinations Feed, a bento-grid view of art from the realtime generation feed.

highlights.title: Pixtral joins image chat
highlights.text: Use Pixtral 12B for vision-capable chat about images. [Find Pixtral](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=Pixtral%2012B).

highlights.title: Llama gains vision
highlights.text: Use `llama-vision` to chat with Cloudflare's Llama 3.2 11B Vision model. [Find llama-vision](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama-vision).

highlights.title: Phi moves to Phi-4
highlights.text: The `phi` model is now configured as Phi-4 Instruct on Cloudflare. [Find phi](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=phi).
